title: Close views of three woven baskets
labels: Close views of three woven baskets
description: Three close views of woven baskets, each with a different pattern of horizontal and vertical strips lying on top.

title: Row 1 and Row 2 of a 10 slit mat
labels: over: the strip lies on top
Row 2 swaps over and under in Row 1
description: Two rows of a 10 slit mat: Row 1 goes 3 over, 2 under and repeats, and Row 2 swaps over and under.

title: Four rows of a 9 slit mat
labels: Row 4 is the same as Row 1
over: the strip lies on top
description: Four rows of a 9 slit mat, each moved one slit to the right, where Row 4 is the same as Row 1.

title: A square, a rectangle and a pentagon
description: A square with every side 6 cm, a rectangle 6 cm by 4 cm and a pentagon with every side 3 cm, labelled Regular, Not regular and Regular.

title: Four rectangles round a point
description: Four rectangles of one size meeting at a point with no gap, and the same four with a dashed fifth rectangle that overlaps two of them.

topic_name: Patterns with More Than One Shape
title: A border of twelve tiles
labels: At every join, a square and a triangle meet
description: A border of twelve tiles in a row, squares and triangles taking turns, with a dot at each join.

title: An isosceles triangle folded in half
description: A triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm and 3 cm, with its 2 equal sides ticked, and the same triangle folded in half with its 2 base angles marked equal.

title: Three triangles named by their sides
description: Triangle A with 3 equal sides of 6 cm, triangle B with sides 7 cm, 5 cm and 4 cm, and triangle C with sides 8 cm, 8 cm and 3 cm, each named by its sides.

title: A kite and a parallelogram with the same sides
description: A kite with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 3 cm and 3 cm next to a parallelogram with sides 5 cm, 3 cm, 5 cm and 3 cm, with equal sides ticked alike.

title: A rectangle and a slanted parallelogram with the same sides
labels: Opposite sides: 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm, 5 cm
description: A rectangle and a slanted parallelogram, both with opposite sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 5 cm, one with 4 right angles and one with none.

title: The seven tangram pieces sorted by sides
labels: The 7 tangram pieces sorted by number of sides
description: The seven tangram pieces in two trays: 5 triangles (2 large, 1 medium, 2 small) and 2 four-sided pieces (a square and a parallelogram), with 5 + 2 = 7.

title: Four shapes and one statement
labels: Opposite sides are equal in all four shapes
description: Four labelled shapes, X a square, Y a rectangle, Z a rhombus and W a parallelogram, with every side length written beside it and right angle marks on X and Y.

title: Two diameters and the shape they make
description: A circle of diameter 10 cm with two diameters joined into a rectangle, and a second circle with two diameters at right angles joined into a square, each with right angle marks.

title: Twelve points, seventeen lines
description: A circle with 12 numbered points joined by 17 lines in the path 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 5, 9, 6, 10, 7, 11, 8, 12, 9, 1, drawn in teal, amber and one reddish purple closing line.

title: Two views of one cube
labels: The heart and the moon both touch the sun and the leaf
So the heart is opposite the moon
description: Two views of a cube: View 1 shows the sun on top, the heart on the left and the leaf on the right; View 2 shows the sun on top, the leaf on the left and the moon on the right.

title: Layers of a painted 4 by 4 by 4 cube
description: Two 4 by 4 grids of coloured cells for the layers of a 4 by 4 by 4 cube with a key for 3, 2, 1 and no painted faces and the total 8 + 24 + 24 + 8 = 64.

title: Nisha's five shapes in a line
labels: (a) The circle is at the left end.
(b) The square is next to the circle.
(c) The triangle is between the square and the hexagon.
(d) The rectangle is to the right of the hexagon.
description: Five numbered boxes in a line holding a circle, a square, a triangle, a hexagon and a rectangle, with the four clues of the puzzle written above.

title: A box with its faces and vertices
description: A box drawn as a wire frame with 8 numbered vertices, the top, front and right faces tinted where they meet at one vertex, and the text 6 faces, 8 vertices and 3 faces meet at this vertex.

title: The 12 edges of a box
description: A box drawn as a wire frame with 4 top edges in teal, 4 bottom edges in amber and 4 standing edges in reddish purple, with the line 6 × 4 = 24 sides, 24 ÷ 2 = 12 edges.

title: The craft table in eight pictures
description: Eight tiles with simple drawings: a woven checkerboard mat, a regular hexagon, three hexagons meeting at a point, a triangle, a kite, a circle with two diameters and a rectangle, a cube and a box.
